free_tier.stated: USD 10 of one-time credit with no card to start, about 440 hours of a small sandbox (2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 50 GB disk) at USD 0.0175 an hour.
free_tier.notes: A Personal workspace holds the credit from signup. A team workspace starts at USD 0 and receives its USD 10 when its first card is saved. A one-time 7-day Pro trial is available in Billing without a card.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a sandbox, not a stored object

retention.stated: A stopped sandbox keeps its disk and memory; storage is free for the first 48 hours, then USD 0.10 per GB-month until the sandbox is deleted. Deleting removes the sandbox, its disk and its snapshots.
retention.notes: The 48-hour figure is a storage-charge threshold, not automatic deletion.

egress.terms: Egress and AI keys are stated at USD 0. Outbound traffic runs through the public internet or a private mesh (Tailscale, Headscale or NetBird) with security groups; metadata and SMTP are never reachable. No per-GB egress price or allowance is published.

interface_detail: The zode CLI, a TypeScript SDK, the HTTP API at https://api.zode.dev and an MCP server; Chrome over CDP and a Linux desktop on Pro and above.
tooling: curl -fsSL https://zode.dev/install | sh installs the zode CLI; npm i @zodedev/sdk for Node 22 and later; REST API and MCP server.
chaining: A coding agent gets its own microVM through the CLI or MCP, forks it for parallel attempts and runs CI on the same machines.

limits.value: 2 sandboxes running at once on Free
USD 10 one-time credit, after which a workspace with no card cannot create, fork or start sandboxes
buffered commands: 30 seconds by default, 55 seconds at most, 16 KB of command
storage free for the first 48 hours, then USD 0.10 per GB-month until delete

limits_note: Compute is billed per second at USD 0.00875 per vCPU-hour. A workspace can set a per-day spend cap; the Free plan's automatic sizing ceiling is medium.
binding_note: The USD 10 one-time credit and the two-sandbox concurrency cap bind first: without a card, credit exhaustion blocks new sandboxes and stops running ones about 15 minutes later.

identity_cost.detail: An account is needed and the console offers Google, GitHub, a one-time email link and a password of at least ten characters; signup requires a permanent email address and rejects throwaway inboxes. The Free credit needs no card; a card or credit purchase is required once it runs out.

reliability_note: Sandboxes run in one region (Belgium); a stopped sandbox restarts on the same host and start fails with HTTP 409 node_full if that host has no free memory. Without a card, credit exhaustion stops running sandboxes within about 15 minutes.
confidence_note: Rates, caps, egress terms and the signup routes are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-24; the identity fields come from the console's own JavaScript.
